zg361_career_hc_reclaim_transfer_hc_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_active = 1
            var:zg361_transfer_hc_reserved = 1
            var:zg361_transfer_hc_conserved = 1
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_vacancy_active value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_vacancy_status value = 4 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_hc_reserved add = -1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_hc_reclaimed add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_hc_partition value = var:zg361_transfer_hc_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_hc_partition add = var:zg361_transfer_hc_reserved }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_hc_partition add = var:zg361_transfer_hc_settled }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_hc_partition add = var:zg361_transfer_hc_reclaimed }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_hc_conserved value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { var:zg361_transfer_hc_partition = var:zg361_transfer_hc_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_hc_conserved value = 1 } }
    }
}

                is_landed = yes

                zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes

                primary_title.tier > root.primary_title.tier
                vassal_count < vassal_limit
                NOT = { is_at_war_with = root.var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_owner }
                NOT = { is_at_war_with = root }

            var:zg361_transfer_hc_authorized = 1

        set_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_cl_receiver value = var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_receiver }

            var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_status = 2
            var:zg361_transfer_cl_phase = 1
            var:zg361_transfer_cl_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$

        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_cl_phase value = 5 }
        zg361_career_hc_reclaim_transfer_hc_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_cl_applied value = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            this = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
            var:zg361_transfer_consumer_kind = 2
            var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_status = 4
            var:zg361_transfer_cl_phase = 5
            var:zg361_transfer_cl_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
            var:zg361_transfer_cl_subject = this
            var:zg361_transfer_cl_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
            var:zg361_transfer_cl_case = $TICKET_CASE$
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_cl_red_code value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_cl_applied value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_cl_red_code value = 3 } }
}

zg361_career_hc_settle_cl_transfer_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_transfer_cl_applied
    set_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_cl_red_code value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:zg361_transfer_consumer_kind = 2
            var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_active = 1
            var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_status = 2
            var:zg361_transfer_cl_phase = 4
            var:zg361_transfer_cl_owner = var:zg361_cl_m319_object_owner
            var:zg361_transfer_cl_subject = this
            var:zg361_transfer_cl_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m319_object_cycle
            var:zg361_transfer_cl_case = var:zg361_cl_m319_object_case
            var:zg361_transfer_cl_vacancy = var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_id
            var:zg361_transfer_cl_receiver = var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_receiver
            var:zg361_transfer_cl_title = var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_title
            var:zg361_transfer_cl_accept_cycle = var:zg361_transfer_cl_cycle
            var:zg361_transfer_cl_accept_case = var:zg361_transfer_cl_case
            var:zg361_transfer_cl_trial_cycle = var:zg361_transfer_cl_cycle
            var:zg361_transfer_cl_trial_case = var:zg361_transfer_cl_case
            var:zg361_transfer_cl_release_cycle = var:zg361_transfer_cl_cycle
            var:zg361_transfer_cl_release_case = var:zg361_transfer_cl_case
            var:zg361_cl_m312_vacancy_id = var:zg361_transfer_cl_vacancy
            var:zg361_cl_m312_target_manager = var:zg361_transfer_cl_receiver
            var:zg361_cl_m312_vacancy_title = var:zg361_transfer_cl_title
            var:zg361_cl_m312_hc_reserved = 1
            var:zg361_cl_m314_vacancy_id = var:zg361_transfer_cl_vacancy
            var:zg361_cl_m314_target_manager = var:zg361_transfer_cl_receiver
            var:zg361_cl_m315_vacancy_id = var:zg361_transfer_cl_vacancy
            var:zg361_cl_m315_source_manager = var:zg361_transfer_cl_owner
            var:zg361_cl_m315_target_manager = var:zg361_transfer_cl_receiver
            var:zg361_cl_m319_vacancy_id = var:zg361_transfer_cl_vacancy
            var:zg361_cl_m319_target_manager = var:zg361_transfer_cl_receiver
            var:zg361_cl_m312_receipt_owner = var:zg361_transfer_cl_owner
            var:zg361_cl_m312_receipt_subject = this
            var:zg361_cl_m312_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_transfer_cl_cycle
            var:zg361_cl_m312_receipt_case = var:zg361_transfer_cl_case
            var:zg361_cl_m312_receipt_choice = 1
            var:zg361_cl_m314_receipt_owner = var:zg361_transfer_cl_owner
            var:zg361_cl_m314_receipt_subject = this
            var:zg361_cl_m314_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_transfer_cl_cycle
            var:zg361_cl_m314_receipt_case = var:zg361_transfer_cl_case
            var:zg361_cl_m314_receipt_choice = 1
            var:zg361_cl_m315_receipt_owner = var:zg361_transfer_cl_owner
            var:zg361_cl_m315_receipt_subject = this
            var:zg361_cl_m315_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_transfer_cl_cycle
            var:zg361_cl_m315_receipt_case = var:zg361_transfer_cl_case
            var:zg361_cl_m315_receipt_choice = 1
            var:zg361_cl_m319_receipt_owner = var:zg361_transfer_cl_owner
            var:zg361_cl_m319_receipt_subject = this
            var:zg361_cl_m319_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_transfer_cl_cycle
            var:zg361_cl_m319_receipt_case = var:zg361_transfer_cl_case
            var:zg361_cl_m319_receipt_choice = 1
            var:zg361_transfer_hc_authorized = 1
            var:zg361_transfer_hc_reserved = 1
            var:zg361_transfer_hc_partition = 1
            var:zg361_transfer_hc_conserved = 1
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                liege = var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_owner
                primary_title = var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_title
                var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_title = { holder = this }
                var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_receiver = {
                    is_landed = yes
                    NOT = { has_trait = gallivanter }
                    zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
                    liege = root.var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_owner
                    primary_title.tier > root.primary_title.tier
                    vassal_count < vassal_limit
                    NOT = { is_at_war_with = root.var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_owner }
                    NOT = { is_at_war_with = root }
                }
                NOT = { is_at_war_with = var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_receiver }
            }
            save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_transfer_cl_settle_subject
            var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_owner = { save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_transfer_cl_settle_owner }
            var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_receiver = { save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_transfer_cl_settle_receiver }
            var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_title = { save_temporary_scope_as = zg361_transfer_cl_settle_title }
            scope:zg361_transfer_cl_settle_owner = {
                create_title_and_vassal_change = {
                    type = granted
                    save_scope_as = zg361_transfer_cl_title_change
                    add_claim_on_loss = no
                }
                scope:zg361_transfer_cl_settle_subject = {
                    change_liege = {
                        liege = scope:zg361_transfer_cl_settle_receiver
                        change = scope:zg361_transfer_cl_title_change
                    }
                }
                resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:zg361_transfer_cl_title_change
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    liege = scope:zg361_transfer_cl_settle_receiver
                    primary_title = scope:zg361_transfer_cl_settle_title
                    scope:zg361_transfer_cl_settle_title.holder = this
                }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_vacancy_active value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_vacancy_status value = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_cl_phase value = 6 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_hc_reserved add = -1 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_hc_settled add = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_hc_partition value = var:zg361_transfer_hc_available }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_hc_partition add = var:zg361_transfer_hc_reserved }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_hc_partition add = var:zg361_transfer_hc_settled }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_hc_partition add = var:zg361_transfer_hc_reclaimed }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_hc_conserved value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { var:zg361_transfer_hc_partition = var:zg361_transfer_hc_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_hc_conserved value = 1 } }
                scope:zg361_transfer_cl_settle_receiver = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_received_transfer_vacancy value = root.var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_id }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_received_transfer_subject value = root }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_received_transfer_title value = scope:zg361_transfer_cl_settle_title }
                }
                scope:zg361_transfer_cl_settle_owner = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_last_settled_transfer_vacancy value = root.var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_id }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_last_settled_transfer_subject value = root }
                }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_cl_applied value = 1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_cl_red_code value = 4 }
                zg361_career_hc_reclaim_transfer_hc_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_cl_red_code value = 1 }
            zg361_career_hc_reclaim_transfer_hc_effect = yes
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            var:zg361_transfer_consumer_kind = 2
            var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_status = 3
            var:zg361_transfer_cl_phase = 6
            var:zg361_transfer_cl_subject = this
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_cl_red_code value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_cl_applied value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_transfer_cl_red_code value = 3 } }
}

# The only manager-scope Career/HC ABI for central wiring.  It selects one
# eligible direct official and opens D only; later domains are hidden D+1 edges.
zg361_career_hc_open_portfolio_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_portfolio_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_game_rule = zg361_on
            zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
            has_variable = zg361_review_serial
            trigger_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = zg361_ch_manager_portfolio_cycle }
                NOT = { var:zg361_ch_manager_portfolio_cycle = var:zg361_review_serial }
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes }
            any_vassal = {
                zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
                liege = root
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_ch_portfolio_cycle }
                    NOT = { var:zg361_ch_portfolio_cycle = root.var:zg361_review_serial }
                }
                trigger_else = { always = yes }
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_d_active }
                    var:zg361_case_d_active = 0
                }
                trigger_else = { always = yes }
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_m_active }
                    var:zg361_case_m_active = 0
                }
                trigger_else = { always = yes }
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_n_active }
                    var:zg361_case_n_active = 0
                }
                trigger_else = { always = yes }
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_o_active }
                    var:zg361_case_o_active = 0
                }
                trigger_else = { always = yes }
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_p_active }
                    var:zg361_case_p_active = 0
                }
                trigger_else = { always = yes }
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_q_active }
                    var:zg361_case_q_active = 0
                }
                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            }
        }
        ordered_vassal = {
            limit = {
                zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
                liege = root
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_ch_portfolio_cycle }
                    NOT = { var:zg361_ch_portfolio_cycle = root.var:zg361_review_serial }
                }
                trigger_else = { always = yes }
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_d_active }
                    var:zg361_case_d_active = 0
                }
                trigger_else = { always = yes }
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_m_active }
                    var:zg361_case_m_active = 0
                }
                trigger_else = { always = yes }
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_n_active }
                    var:zg361_case_n_active = 0
                }
                trigger_else = { always = yes }
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_o_active }
                    var:zg361_case_o_active = 0
                }
                trigger_else = { always = yes }
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_p_active }
                    var:zg361_case_p_active = 0
                }
                trigger_else = { always = yes }
                trigger_if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_q_active }
                    var:zg361_case_q_active = 0
                }
                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            }
            order_by = stewardship
            position = 0
            zg361_career_hc_open_d_case_effect = yes
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied var:zg361_ch_runtime_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_portfolio_cycle value = root.var:zg361_review_serial }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_portfolio_closed value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_portfolio_owner value = root }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_portfolio_subject value = this }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_portfolio_open_case value = var:zg361_case_d_case_serial }
                root = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_manager_portfolio_cycle value = var:zg361_review_serial }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_manager_portfolio_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_portfolio_applied value = 1 }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Open domain D on one assessed direct vassal.

        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m021_gold_status value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m025_treasury_available value = 5 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m025_treasury_reserved value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m025_treasury_settled value = 0 }

        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_s3_x_deadline_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_s3_x_deadline_expired value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_s4_x_deadline_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_s4_x_deadline_expired value = 0 }

            var:zg361_case_d_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_ch_d_event_owner }
            save_scope_as = zg361_ch_d_event_subject
            save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_d_event_cycle value = var:zg361_case_d_cycle_serial }
            save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_d_event_case value = var:zg361_case_d_case_serial }
            zg361_career_hc_schedule_d_stage_01_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
                zg361_career_hc_d_run_authorized_ai_effect = yes
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { root = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
                root = { trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.19 days = 1 } }
            }
            debug_log = "ZG361CH: opened D career/HC case"
        }
    }
}

# Authorized second-AI-exception path: consume the same numbered
# receipts and consumers without opening any player business event.
zg361_career_hc_d_run_authorized_ai_effect = {
    zg361_career_hc_m019_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    zg361_career_hc_m020_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    if = {
            limit = {
                government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                root = {
                    government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                    treasury >= 5
                    gold >= 5
                }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m021_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            zg361_career_hc_m021_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 3 }
        }
    zg361_career_hc_m022_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    zg361_career_hc_m023_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    zg361_career_hc_m024_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    if = {
            limit = {
                government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                root = {
                    government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                    treasury >= 5
                    gold >= 5
                }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m025_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            zg361_career_hc_m025_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 3 }
        }
    if = {
            limit = { has_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied var:zg361_ch_runtime_applied = 1 }
            root = { trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.951 days = 1 } }
        }
}

zg361_career_hc_resolve_d_outcome_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:zg361_ch_d_completed = var:zg361_ch_d_authorized
            var:zg361_ch_d_conserved = 1
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_d_favorable > var:zg361_ch_d_extractive }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_outcome value = 1 }
            add_prestige = 50
            var:zg361_case_d_owner = { add_prestige = 25 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_d_extractive > var:zg361_ch_d_favorable }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_outcome value = -1 }
            add_stress = minor_stress_gain
            var:zg361_case_d_owner = { add_prestige = { value = 0 subtract = 25 } }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_outcome value = 0 }
            add_prestige = 10
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_visible_receipt_revision value = var:zg361_case_d_revision }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_d_owner = { is_ai = no } }
            var:zg361_case_d_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.901 days = 1 } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { is_ai = no }
            trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.901 days = 1 }
        }
        debug_log = "ZG361CH: completed D career/HC case"
    }
}

            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = root
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_d_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_d_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_d_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_d_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_d_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = root
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_d_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_m019_core_effect = { ROUTE = $ROUTE$ }
    }
}

# Assessed-official self response; grants no manager/HC/panel authority.

    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_subject_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_ai = no
            zg361_case_kernel_subject_self_guard_trigger = {
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_d_subject
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_d_active
            }
            has_variable = zg361_case_d_state
            var:zg361_case_d_state = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m019_subject_ack = 0
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 3
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m019_subject_ack value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m019_subject_route value = scope:zg361_ch_subject_route }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_case_d_feedback_revision add = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CH: subject response 019 recorded"
    }
}

# 019 晋升资格门槛
zg361_career_hc_m019_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_d_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_d_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_d_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_d_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_d_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_d_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_d_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m019_receipt_active
            var:zg361_ch_m019_receipt_active = 0

        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_d_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_d_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_d_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_d_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_d_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_d_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_d_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_d_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_d_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_d_last_choice
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m019_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ch_m019_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m019_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m019_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ch_m019_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ch_m019_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_d_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_d_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 1
            CHOICE = $ROUTE$
            OPERATION_ID = 19
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m019_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m019_route value = scope:zg361_ch_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m019_value value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m019_value value = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m019_value value = -1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m019_deferred value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m019_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_d_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m019_consume_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m019_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_d_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_d_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_d_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_d_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_d_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_d_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_d_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m019_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m019_consumed = 0
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m019_value
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m019_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_completed add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m019_value > 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_favorable add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_used add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m019_value < 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_extractive add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m019_route = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_promotion_eligible value = var:zg361_ch_m019_value }
        }


        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_d_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_d_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_d_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_d_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_d_try_advance_01_effect = yes
    }
}

            liege = root

    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_subject_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_ai = no
            zg361_case_kernel_subject_self_guard_trigger = {
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_d_subject
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_d_active
            }
            has_variable = zg361_case_d_state

            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 3
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m020_subject_ack value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m020_subject_route value = scope:zg361_ch_subject_route }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_case_d_feedback_revision add = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CH: subject response 020 recorded"
    }
}

# 020 晋升包与跨部门答辩
zg361_career_hc_m020_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_d_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_d_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_d_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_d_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_d_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_d_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_d_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m020_receipt_active
            var:zg361_ch_m020_receipt_active = 0

        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_d_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_d_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_d_case_serial

            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_d_revision

            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_d_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_d_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_d_last_choice
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m020_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ch_m020_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m020_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m020_receipt_case

            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ch_m020_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_d_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_d_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 1
            CHOICE = $ROUTE$
            OPERATION_ID = 20
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m020_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m020_route value = scope:zg361_ch_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m020_value value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m020_value value = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m020_value value = -1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m020_deferred value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m020_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_d_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m020_consume_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m020_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_d_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_d_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_d_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_d_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_d_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_d_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_d_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m020_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m020_consumed = 0
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m020_value
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m020_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_completed add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m020_value > 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_favorable add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_used add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m020_value < 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_extractive add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m020_route = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_promotion_packet_state value = var:zg361_ch_m020_route }
        }


        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_d_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_d_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_d_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_d_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_d_try_advance_01_effect = yes
    }
}

            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 3
            }

                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_d_owner

                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 2

                    government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                    treasury >= 5
                    gold >= 5
                }
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes }
        }

            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_d_last_choice

            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ch_m021_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m021_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m021_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ch_m021_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ch_m021_receipt_route

            OPERATION_ID = 21

                limit = {

                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 2

                zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_d_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_d_subject

                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_d_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_d_active
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_d_revision
                AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m021_treasury_available
                RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m021_treasury_reserved

                RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m021_treasury_status
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m021_treasury_owner

                TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_d_cycle_serial

                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m021_treasury_status

                    TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                    TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                    TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_d_case_serial
                    TICKET_STATE = 2
                }
            }
                if = {
                    limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                    zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_d_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_d_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_d_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_d_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_d_active

            }

                        var:zg361_ch_m021_gold_status = 2

                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_d_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_d_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_d_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_d_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_d_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 2
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m022_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m022_consumed = 0
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m022_value
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m022_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_completed add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m022_value > 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_favorable add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_used add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m022_value < 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_extractive add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m022_route = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_soft_hc_budget value = var:zg361_ch_m022_route }
        }


        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_d_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_d_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_d_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_d_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_d_try_advance_02_effect = yes
    }
}

# 023 HC 答辩与团队投入产出
zg361_career_hc_m023_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_d_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_d_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_d_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_d_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_d_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_d_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_d_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 3
            }
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m023_receipt_active
            var:zg361_ch_m023_receipt_active = 0

        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_d_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_d_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_d_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_d_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_d_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_d_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_d_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_d_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_d_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_d_last_choice
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m023_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ch_m023_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m023_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m023_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ch_m023_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ch_m023_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_d_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_d_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 3
            CHOICE = $ROUTE$
            OPERATION_ID = 23
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m023_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m023_route value = scope:zg361_ch_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m023_value value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m023_value value = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m023_value value = -1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m023_deferred value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m023_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_d_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m023_consume_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {

                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_d_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_d_case_serial

            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_debt add = 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_jingcha_treasury_delta value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_jingcha_personal_delta value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_defense_year value = current_year }


        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_d_available }

            limit = { var:zg361_ch_d_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_d_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_d_try_advance_03_effect = yes
    }

# 025 高绩效人才被挖与反 offer
zg361_career_hc_m025_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_d_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_d_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_d_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_d_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_d_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_d_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_d_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m025_receipt_active
            var:zg361_ch_m025_receipt_active = 0
            trigger_if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                    }
                }
                government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                var:zg361_case_d_owner = {
                    government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                    treasury >= 5
                    gold >= 5
                }
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes }
        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_d_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_d_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_d_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_d_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_d_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_d_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_d_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_d_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_d_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_d_last_choice
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_d_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_d_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 4
            CHOICE = $ROUTE$
            OPERATION_ID = 25
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_d_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_d_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_d_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_d_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_d_active
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_d_revision
                AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_treasury_available
                RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_treasury_reserved
                RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_treasury_amount
                RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_treasury_status
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_treasury_owner
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_treasury_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_treasury_case
                TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_d_owner
                TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_d_case_serial
                TICKET_STATE = 4
                AMOUNT = 5
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_d_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_d_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_d_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_d_state
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_d_active
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_d_revision
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_treasury_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_treasury_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_treasury_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_treasury_status
                    TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_d_owner
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                    TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                    TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_d_case_serial
                    TICKET_STATE = 4
                }
            }
                if = {
                    limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                    zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_d_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_d_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_d_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_d_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_d_active
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_d_revision
                AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_gold_available
                RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_gold_reserved
                RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_gold_amount
                RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_gold_status
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_gold_owner
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_gold_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_gold_case
                TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_d_owner
                TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_d_case_serial
                TICKET_STATE = 4
                AMOUNT = 5
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_d_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_d_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_d_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_d_state
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_d_active
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_d_revision
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_gold_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_gold_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_gold_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m025_gold_status
                    TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_d_owner
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                    TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                    TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_d_case_serial
                    TICKET_STATE = 4
                }
            }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1
                        var:zg361_ch_m025_treasury_status = 2
                        var:zg361_ch_m025_gold_status = 2
                    }
                    var:zg361_case_d_owner = {
                        remove_treasury = 5
                        add_gold = { value = 0 subtract = 5 }
                    }
                    add_treasury = 5
                    add_gold = 5
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m025_dual_payment_settled value = 1 }
                }
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m025_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m025_route value = scope:zg361_ch_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m025_value value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m025_value value = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m025_value value = -1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m025_deferred value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m025_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_d_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m025_consume_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m025_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_d_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_d_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_d_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_d_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_d_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_d_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_d_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_d_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m025_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m025_consumed = 0
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m025_value
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m025_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_completed add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m025_value > 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_favorable add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_used add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m025_value < 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_extractive add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m025_route = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_counteroffer_terminal value = var:zg361_ch_m025_route }
        }


        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_d_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_d_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_d_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_d_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_d_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_d_try_advance_04_effect = yes
    }
}

# Open domain M on one assessed direct vassal.
zg361_career_hc_open_m_case_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            root = {
                zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
                has_variable = zg361_review_serial
            }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = root
        }
        zg361_case_m_open_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_authorized value = 6 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_available value = 6 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_used value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_debt value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_completed value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_favorable value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_extractive value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_outcome value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_conserved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_micro_level value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_management_authority value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m092_receipt_active value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m092_consumed value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m092_subject_ack value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m092_deferred value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m093_receipt_active value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m093_consumed value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m093_subject_ack value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m093_deferred value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m094_receipt_active value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m094_consumed value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m094_subject_ack value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m094_deferred value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m095_receipt_active value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m095_consumed value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m095_subject_ack value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m095_deferred value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m096_receipt_active value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m096_consumed value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m096_subject_ack value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m096_deferred value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m097_receipt_active value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m097_consumed value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m097_subject_ack value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m097_deferred value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_s1_x_deadline_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_s1_x_deadline_expired value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_s2_x_deadline_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_s2_x_deadline_expired value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_s3_x_deadline_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_s3_x_deadline_expired value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_s4_x_deadline_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_s4_x_deadline_expired value = 0 }

            var:zg361_case_m_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_ch_m_event_owner }
            save_scope_as = zg361_ch_m_event_subject
            save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_m_event_cycle value = var:zg361_case_m_cycle_serial }
            save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_m_event_case value = var:zg361_case_m_case_serial }
            zg361_career_hc_schedule_m_stage_01_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
                zg361_career_hc_m_run_authorized_ai_effect = yes
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { root = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
                root = { trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.92 days = 1 } }
            }
            debug_log = "ZG361CH: opened M career/HC case"
        }
    }
}

# Authorized second-AI-exception path: consume the same numbered
# receipts and consumers without opening any player business event.
zg361_career_hc_m_run_authorized_ai_effect = {
    zg361_career_hc_m092_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    zg361_career_hc_m093_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    zg361_career_hc_m094_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    zg361_career_hc_m095_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    zg361_career_hc_m096_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    zg361_career_hc_m097_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    if = {
            limit = { has_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied var:zg361_ch_runtime_applied = 1 }
            root = { trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.952 days = 1 } }
        }
}

            zg361_career_hc_resolve_m_outcome_effect = yes
        }
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m_timeout_stage_04_effect = {
    zg361_career_hc_m097_core_effect = { ROUTE = 3 }
    debug_log = "ZG361CH: exact M stage 4 deadline consumed"
}

zg361_career_hc_resolve_m_outcome_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:zg361_ch_m_completed = var:zg361_ch_m_authorized
            var:zg361_ch_m_conserved = 1
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m_favorable > var:zg361_ch_m_extractive }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_outcome value = 1 }
            add_prestige = 50
            var:zg361_case_m_owner = { add_prestige = 25 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m_extractive > var:zg361_ch_m_favorable }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_outcome value = -1 }
            add_stress = minor_stress_gain
            var:zg361_case_m_owner = { add_prestige = { value = 0 subtract = 25 } }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_outcome value = 0 }
            add_prestige = 10
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_visible_receipt_revision value = var:zg361_case_m_revision }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_m_owner = { is_ai = no } }
            var:zg361_case_m_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.902 days = 1 } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { is_ai = no }
            trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.902 days = 1 }
        }
        debug_log = "ZG361CH: completed M career/HC case"
    }
}

    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_m_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_m_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_m_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_m_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_m_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_m_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_m_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_m_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_m_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m092_receipt_active
            var:zg361_ch_m092_receipt_active = 0

        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_m_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_m_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_m_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_m_case_serial

            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_m_revision

            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_m_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_m_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_m_last_choice
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m092_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ch_m092_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m092_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m092_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ch_m092_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ch_m092_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_m_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_m_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_m_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 1
            CHOICE = $ROUTE$
            OPERATION_ID = 92
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m092_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m092_route value = scope:zg361_ch_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m092_value value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m092_value value = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m092_value value = -1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m092_deferred value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m092_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_m_cycle_serial add = 1 } }

        }

}

zg361_career_hc_m092_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {

                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_m_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_m_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_m_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_m_state

                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_m_cycle_serial

        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m092_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_completed add = 1 }
        if = {

            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_favorable add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_used add = 1 }
        }

            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_extractive add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m092_route = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_career_track value = var:zg361_ch_m092_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_management_authority value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_ch_m092_route = 2 zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_management_authority value = 1 } }
        }


        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_m_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_m_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_m_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_m_try_advance_01_effect = yes
    }
}

            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m094_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_m_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_m_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_m_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_m_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_m_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_m_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_m_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_m_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_m_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 2
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m094_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m094_consumed = 0
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m094_value
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m094_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_completed add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m094_value > 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_favorable add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_used add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m094_value < 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_extractive add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m094_route = 3 } }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_micro_level add = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_title_unchanged value = 1 }
        }


        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_m_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_m_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_m_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_m_try_advance_02_effect = yes
    }
}

# 095 高级管理任命年度复审
zg361_career_hc_m095_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_m_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_m_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_m_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_m_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_m_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_m_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_m_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_m_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_m_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 3
            }
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m095_receipt_active
            var:zg361_ch_m095_receipt_active = 0

        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_m_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_m_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_m_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_m_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_m_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_m_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_m_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_m_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_m_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_m_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_m_last_choice
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m095_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ch_m095_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m095_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m095_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ch_m095_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ch_m095_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_m_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_m_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_m_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 3
            CHOICE = $ROUTE$
            OPERATION_ID = 95
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m095_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m095_route value = scope:zg361_ch_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m095_value value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m095_value value = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m095_value value = -1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m095_deferred value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m095_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_m_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m095_consume_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

# Authorized second-AI-exception path: consume the same numbered
# receipts and consumers without opening any player business event.
zg361_career_hc_n_run_authorized_ai_effect = {
    zg361_career_hc_m098_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    zg361_career_hc_m099_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    zg361_career_hc_m100_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    if = {
            limit = {
                government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                root = {
                    government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                    treasury >= 5
                    gold >= 5
                }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m101_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            zg361_career_hc_m101_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 3 }
        }
    zg361_career_hc_m102_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    zg361_career_hc_m103_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    if = {
            limit = {
                government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                root = {
                    government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                    treasury >= 5
                    gold >= 5
                }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m104_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            zg361_career_hc_m104_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 3 }
        }
    zg361_career_hc_m105_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    if = {
            limit = { has_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied var:zg361_ch_runtime_applied = 1 }
            root = { trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.953 days = 1 } }
        }
}
