zg361_career_hc_resolve_n_outcome_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:zg361_ch_n_completed = var:zg361_ch_n_authorized
            var:zg361_ch_n_conserved = 1
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_n_favorable > var:zg361_ch_n_extractive }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_outcome value = 1 }
            add_prestige = 50
            var:zg361_case_n_owner = { add_prestige = 25 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_n_extractive > var:zg361_ch_n_favorable }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_outcome value = -1 }
            add_stress = minor_stress_gain
            var:zg361_case_n_owner = { add_prestige = { value = 0 subtract = 25 } }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_outcome value = 0 }
            add_prestige = 10
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_visible_receipt_revision value = var:zg361_case_n_revision }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_n_owner = { is_ai = no } }
            var:zg361_case_n_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.903 days = 1 } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { is_ai = no }
            trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.903 days = 1 }
        }
        debug_log = "ZG361CH: completed N career/HC case"
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m098_manager_apply_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            root = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = root
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_n_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_n_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_n_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_n_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_n_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = root
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_n_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_m098_core_effect = { ROUTE = $ROUTE$ }
    }
}

# 098 增长、补缺、项目三类 HC
zg361_career_hc_m098_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_n_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_n_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_n_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_n_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_n_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_n_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_n_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m098_receipt_active
            var:zg361_ch_m098_receipt_active = 0

        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_n_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_n_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_n_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_n_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_n_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_n_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_n_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_n_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_n_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_n_last_choice
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m098_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ch_m098_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m098_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m098_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ch_m098_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ch_m098_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_n_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_n_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 1
            CHOICE = $ROUTE$
            OPERATION_ID = 98
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m098_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m098_route value = scope:zg361_ch_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m098_value value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m098_value value = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m098_value value = -1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m098_deferred value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m098_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m098_consume_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m098_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_n_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_n_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_n_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_n_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_n_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_n_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_n_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m098_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m098_consumed = 0
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m098_value
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m098_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_completed add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m098_value > 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_favorable add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_used add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m098_value < 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_extractive add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m098_route = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_mechanism_098_source value = var:zg361_ch_m098_route }
        }
        if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_ch_m098_route = 1 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_available add = -1 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_reserved add = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_ch_m098_route = 2 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_available add = -1 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_frozen add = 1 }
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition value = var:zg361_ch_hc_available }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition add = var:zg361_ch_hc_reserved }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition add = var:zg361_ch_hc_occupied }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition add = var:zg361_ch_hc_frozen }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition add = var:zg361_ch_hc_reclaimed }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_conserved value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_ch_hc_partition = var:zg361_ch_hc_authorized }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_conserved value = 1 }
            }

        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_n_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_n_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_n_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_n_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_n_try_advance_01_effect = yes
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m099_manager_apply_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            root = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = root
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_n_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_n_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_n_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_n_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_n_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = root
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_n_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_m099_core_effect = { ROUTE = $ROUTE$ }
    }
}

                scope:zg361_ch_route = 1

                scope:zg361_ch_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_n_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_n_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_n_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_n_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_n_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_n_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_n_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 2
            }
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m101_receipt_active
            var:zg361_ch_m101_receipt_active = 0
            trigger_if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                    }
                }
                government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                var:zg361_case_n_owner = {
                    government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                    treasury >= 5
                    gold >= 5
                }
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes }
        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_n_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_n_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_n_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_n_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_n_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_n_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_n_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_n_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_n_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_n_last_choice
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_n_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_n_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 2
            CHOICE = $ROUTE$
            OPERATION_ID = 101
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_n_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_n_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_n_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_n_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_n_active
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_n_revision
                AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_treasury_available
                RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_treasury_reserved
                RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_treasury_amount
                RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_treasury_status
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_treasury_owner
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_treasury_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_treasury_case
                TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_n_owner
                TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_n_case_serial
                TICKET_STATE = 2
                AMOUNT = 5
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_n_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_n_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_n_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_n_state
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_n_active
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_n_revision
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_treasury_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_treasury_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_treasury_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_treasury_status
                    TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_n_owner
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                    TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                    TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_n_case_serial
                    TICKET_STATE = 2
                }
            }
                if = {
                    limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                    zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_n_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_n_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_n_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_n_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_n_active
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_n_revision
                AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_gold_available
                RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_gold_reserved
                RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_gold_amount
                RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_gold_status
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_gold_owner
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_gold_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_gold_case
                TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_n_owner
                TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_n_case_serial
                TICKET_STATE = 2
                AMOUNT = 5
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_n_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_n_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_n_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_n_state
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_n_active
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_n_revision
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_gold_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_gold_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_gold_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m101_gold_status
                    TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_n_owner
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                    TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                    TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_n_case_serial
                    TICKET_STATE = 2
                }
            }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1
                        var:zg361_ch_m101_treasury_status = 2
                        var:zg361_ch_m101_gold_status = 2
                    }
                    var:zg361_case_n_owner = {
                        remove_treasury = 5
                        add_gold = { value = 0 subtract = 5 }
                    }
                    add_treasury = 5
                    add_gold = 5
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m101_dual_payment_settled value = 1 }
                }
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m101_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m101_route value = scope:zg361_ch_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m101_value value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m101_value value = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m101_value value = -1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m101_deferred value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m101_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m101_consume_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m101_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_n_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_n_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_n_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_n_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_n_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_n_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_n_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 2
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m101_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m101_consumed = 0
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m101_value
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m101_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_completed add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m101_value > 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_favorable add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_used add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m101_value < 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_extractive add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m101_route = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_mechanism_101_source value = var:zg361_ch_m101_route }
        }
        if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_ch_m101_route = 1 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_available add = -1 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_occupied add = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_ch_m101_route = 2 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_available add = -1 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_occupied add = 1 }
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition value = var:zg361_ch_hc_available }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition add = var:zg361_ch_hc_reserved }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition add = var:zg361_ch_hc_occupied }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition add = var:zg361_ch_hc_frozen }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition add = var:zg361_ch_hc_reclaimed }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_conserved value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_ch_hc_partition = var:zg361_ch_hc_authorized }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_conserved value = 1 }
            }

        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_n_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_n_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_n_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_n_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_n_try_advance_02_effect = yes
    }
}

    if = {

            root = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }

                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_n_owner

                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_n_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_n_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_n_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = root
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_n_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 3
            }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_m102_core_effect = { ROUTE = $ROUTE$ }
    }
}

    if = {

            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_n_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 3
            CHOICE = $ROUTE$
            OPERATION_ID = 103
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m103_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m103_route value = scope:zg361_ch_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m103_value value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m103_value value = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m103_value value = -1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m103_deferred value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m103_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m103_consume_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m103_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_n_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_n_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_n_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_n_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_n_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_n_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_n_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 3
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m103_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m103_consumed = 0
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m103_value
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m103_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_completed add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m103_value > 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_favorable add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_used add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m103_value < 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_extractive add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m103_route = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_mechanism_103_source value = var:zg361_ch_m103_route }
        }
        if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_ch_m103_route = 1 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_available add = -1 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_reclaimed add = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_ch_m103_route = 2 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_available add = -1 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_frozen add = 1 }
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition value = var:zg361_ch_hc_available }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition add = var:zg361_ch_hc_reserved }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition add = var:zg361_ch_hc_occupied }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition add = var:zg361_ch_hc_frozen }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition add = var:zg361_ch_hc_reclaimed }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_conserved value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_ch_hc_partition = var:zg361_ch_hc_authorized }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_conserved value = 1 }
            }

        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_n_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_n_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_n_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_n_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_n_try_advance_03_effect = yes
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m104_manager_apply_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            root = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = root
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_n_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_n_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_n_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_n_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_n_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = root
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_n_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_m104_core_effect = { ROUTE = $ROUTE$ }
    }
}

# 104 新人池 / 成熟人才池之争
zg361_career_hc_m104_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_n_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_n_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_n_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_n_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_n_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_n_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_n_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m104_receipt_active
            var:zg361_ch_m104_receipt_active = 0
            trigger_if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                    }
                }
                government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                var:zg361_case_n_owner = {
                    government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                    treasury >= 5
                    gold >= 5
                }
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes }
        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_n_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_n_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_n_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_n_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_n_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_n_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_n_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_n_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_n_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_n_last_choice
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_n_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_n_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 4
            CHOICE = $ROUTE$
            OPERATION_ID = 104
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_n_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_n_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_n_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_n_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_n_active
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_n_revision
                AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_treasury_available
                RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_treasury_reserved
                RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_treasury_amount
                RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_treasury_status
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_treasury_owner
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_treasury_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_treasury_case
                TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_n_owner
                TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_n_case_serial
                TICKET_STATE = 4
                AMOUNT = 5
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_n_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_n_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_n_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_n_state
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_n_active
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_n_revision
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_treasury_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_treasury_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_treasury_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_treasury_status
                    TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_n_owner
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                    TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                    TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_n_case_serial
                    TICKET_STATE = 4
                }
            }
                if = {
                    limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                    zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_n_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_n_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_n_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_n_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_n_active
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_n_revision
                AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_gold_available
                RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_gold_reserved
                RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_gold_amount
                RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_gold_status
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_gold_owner
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_gold_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_gold_case
                TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_n_owner
                TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_n_case_serial
                TICKET_STATE = 4
                AMOUNT = 5
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_n_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_n_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_n_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_n_state
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_n_active
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_n_revision
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_gold_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_gold_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_gold_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m104_gold_status
                    TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_n_owner
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                    TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                    TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_n_case_serial
                    TICKET_STATE = 4
                }
            }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1
                        var:zg361_ch_m104_treasury_status = 2
                        var:zg361_ch_m104_gold_status = 2
                    }
                    var:zg361_case_n_owner = {
                        remove_treasury = 5
                        add_gold = { value = 0 subtract = 5 }
                    }
                    add_treasury = 5
                    add_gold = 5
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m104_dual_payment_settled value = 1 }
                }
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m104_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m104_route value = scope:zg361_ch_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m104_value value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m104_value value = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m104_value value = -1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m104_deferred value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m104_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m104_consume_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m104_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_n_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_n_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_n_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_n_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_n_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_n_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_n_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_n_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m104_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m104_consumed = 0
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m104_value
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m104_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_completed add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m104_value > 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_favorable add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_used add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m104_value < 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_extractive add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m104_route = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_mechanism_104_source value = var:zg361_ch_m104_route }
        }
        if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_ch_m104_route = 1 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_available add = -1 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_occupied add = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_ch_m104_route = 2 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_available add = -1 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_occupied add = 1 }
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition value = var:zg361_ch_hc_available }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition add = var:zg361_ch_hc_reserved }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition add = var:zg361_ch_hc_occupied }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition add = var:zg361_ch_hc_frozen }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition add = var:zg361_ch_hc_reclaimed }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_conserved value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_ch_hc_partition = var:zg361_ch_hc_authorized }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_conserved value = 1 }
            }

        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_n_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_n_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_n_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_n_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_n_try_advance_04_effect = yes
    }
}

            var:zg361_ch_m105_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m105_consumed = 0
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m105_value
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m105_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_completed add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m105_value > 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_favorable add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_used add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m105_value < 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_extractive add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m105_route = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_mechanism_105_source value = var:zg361_ch_m105_route }
        }
        if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_ch_m105_route = 1 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_available add = -1 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_reserved add = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_ch_m105_route = 2 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_available add = -1 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_frozen add = 1 }
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition value = var:zg361_ch_hc_available }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition add = var:zg361_ch_hc_reserved }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition add = var:zg361_ch_hc_occupied }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition add = var:zg361_ch_hc_frozen }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_partition add = var:zg361_ch_hc_reclaimed }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_conserved value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_ch_hc_partition = var:zg361_ch_hc_authorized }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hc_conserved value = 1 }
            }

        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_n_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_n_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_n_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_n_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_n_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_n_try_advance_04_effect = yes
    }
}

        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_s5_x_deadline_expired value = 0 }

            var:zg361_case_o_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_ch_o_event_owner }
            save_scope_as = zg361_ch_o_event_subject
            save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_o_event_cycle value = var:zg361_case_o_cycle_serial }

                zg361_career_hc_o_run_authorized_ai_effect = yes
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { root = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
                root = { trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.106 days = 1 } }
            }
            debug_log = "ZG361CH: opened O career/HC case"
        }
    }
}

# Authorized second-AI-exception path: consume the same numbered
# receipts and consumers without opening any player business event.
zg361_career_hc_o_run_authorized_ai_effect = {
    zg361_career_hc_m106_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    zg361_career_hc_m107_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    zg361_career_hc_m108_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    zg361_career_hc_m109_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    zg361_career_hc_m110_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    zg361_career_hc_m111_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    if = {
            limit = {
                government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                root = {
                    government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                    treasury >= 5
                    gold >= 5
                }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m112_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            zg361_career_hc_m112_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 3 }
        }
    zg361_career_hc_m113_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    if = {
            limit = { has_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied var:zg361_ch_runtime_applied = 1 }
            root = { trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.954 days = 1 } }
        }
}

                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_o_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_o_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_o_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_o_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_o_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 5
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m113_consumed = 1
        }
        zg361_case_o_advance_05_effect = {
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_o_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_o_case_serial
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            zg361_career_hc_resolve_o_outcome_effect = yes
        }
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_o_timeout_stage_05_effect = {
    zg361_career_hc_m113_core_effect = { ROUTE = 3 }
    debug_log = "ZG361CH: exact O stage 5 deadline consumed"
}

zg361_career_hc_resolve_o_outcome_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:zg361_ch_o_completed = var:zg361_ch_o_authorized
            var:zg361_ch_o_conserved = 1
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_o_favorable > var:zg361_ch_o_extractive }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_outcome value = 1 }
            add_prestige = 50
            var:zg361_case_o_owner = { add_prestige = 25 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_o_extractive > var:zg361_ch_o_favorable }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_outcome value = -1 }
            add_stress = minor_stress_gain
            var:zg361_case_o_owner = { add_prestige = { value = 0 subtract = 25 } }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_outcome value = 0 }
            add_prestige = 10
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_visible_receipt_revision value = var:zg361_case_o_revision }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_o_owner = { is_ai = no } }
            var:zg361_case_o_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.904 days = 1 } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { is_ai = no }
            trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.904 days = 1 }
        }
        debug_log = "ZG361CH: completed O career/HC case"
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m106_manager_apply_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            root = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = root
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_o_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_o_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_o_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_o_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_o_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = root
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_o_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_m106_core_effect = { ROUTE = $ROUTE$ }
    }
}

# 106 关键岗位与关键人才分离
zg361_career_hc_m106_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_o_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_o_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_o_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_o_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_o_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_o_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_o_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m106_receipt_active
            var:zg361_ch_m106_receipt_active = 0

        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_o_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_o_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_o_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_o_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_o_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_o_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_o_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_o_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_o_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_o_last_choice
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m106_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ch_m106_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m106_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m106_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ch_m106_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ch_m106_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_o_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_o_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 1
            CHOICE = $ROUTE$
            OPERATION_ID = 106
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m106_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m106_route value = scope:zg361_ch_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m106_value value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m106_value value = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m106_value value = -1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m106_deferred value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m106_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_o_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m106_consume_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m106_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_o_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_o_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_o_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_o_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_o_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_o_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_o_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m106_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m106_consumed = 0
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m106_value
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m106_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_completed add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m106_value > 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_favorable add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_used add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m106_value < 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_extractive add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m106_route = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_critical_role_label value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_key_talent_label value = var:zg361_ch_m106_route }
        }


        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_o_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_o_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_o_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_o_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_o_try_advance_01_effect = yes
    }
}

                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_o_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_o_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_o_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_o_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 2
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m108_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m108_consumed = 0
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m108_value
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m108_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_completed add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m108_value > 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_favorable add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_used add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m108_value < 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_extractive add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m108_route = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_acting_authority_bound value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_acting_capacity_units value = 1 }
        }


        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_o_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_o_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_o_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_o_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_o_try_advance_02_effect = yes
    }
}

# Assessed-official self response; grants no manager/HC/panel authority.
zg361_career_hc_m109_subject_response_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_subject_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_ai = no
            zg361_case_kernel_subject_self_guard_trigger = {
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_o_subject
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_o_active
            }
            has_variable = zg361_case_o_state
            var:zg361_case_o_state = 2
            var:zg361_ch_m109_subject_ack = 0
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 3
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m109_subject_ack value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m109_subject_route value = scope:zg361_ch_subject_route }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_case_o_feedback_revision add = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CH: subject response 109 recorded"
    }
}

# 109 高潜标签的公开层级
zg361_career_hc_m109_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_o_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_o_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_o_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_o_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_o_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_o_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_o_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 2
            }
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m109_receipt_active
            var:zg361_ch_m109_receipt_active = 0

        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_o_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_o_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_o_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_o_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_o_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_o_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_o_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_o_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_o_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_o_last_choice
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m109_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ch_m109_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m109_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m109_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ch_m109_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ch_m109_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_o_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_o_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 2
            CHOICE = $ROUTE$
            OPERATION_ID = 109
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m109_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m109_route value = scope:zg361_ch_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m109_value value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m109_value value = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m109_value value = -1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m109_deferred value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m109_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_o_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m109_consume_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m109_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_o_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_o_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_o_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_o_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_o_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_o_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_o_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 2
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m109_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m109_consumed = 0
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m109_value
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m109_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_completed add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m109_value > 0 }

            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_used add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {

            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m109_route = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_high_potential_visibility value = var:zg361_ch_m109_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_high_potential_subject_can_read value = 1 }
        }


        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_o_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_o_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_o_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_o_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_o_try_advance_02_effect = yes
    }

            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_attrition_class value = var:zg361_ch_m111_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_attrition_hc_released value = 1 }
        }


        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_o_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_o_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_o_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_o_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_o_try_advance_03_effect = yes
    }
}

    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {

# Assessed-official self response; grants no manager/HC/panel authority.
zg361_career_hc_m112_subject_response_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_subject_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_ai = no
            zg361_case_kernel_subject_self_guard_trigger = {
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_o_subject
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_o_active
            }
            has_variable = zg361_case_o_state
            var:zg361_case_o_state = 4
            var:zg361_ch_m112_subject_ack = 0
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 3
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m112_subject_ack value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m112_subject_route value = scope:zg361_ch_subject_route }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_case_o_feedback_revision add = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CH: subject response 112 recorded"
    }
}

# 112 留任访谈（Stay Interview）
zg361_career_hc_m112_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_o_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_o_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_o_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_o_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_o_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_o_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_o_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m112_receipt_active
            var:zg361_ch_m112_receipt_active = 0
            trigger_if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                    }
                }
                government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                var:zg361_case_o_owner = {
                    government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                    treasury >= 5
                    gold >= 5
                }
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes }
        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_o_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_o_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_o_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_o_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_o_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_o_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_o_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_o_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_o_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_o_last_choice
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_o_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_o_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 4
            CHOICE = $ROUTE$
            OPERATION_ID = 112
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_o_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_o_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_o_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_o_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_o_active
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_o_revision
                AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_treasury_available
                RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_treasury_reserved
                RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_treasury_amount
                RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_treasury_status
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_treasury_owner
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_treasury_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_treasury_case
                TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_o_owner
                TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
                TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_o_case_serial
                TICKET_STATE = 4
                AMOUNT = 5
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_o_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_o_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_o_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_o_state
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_o_active
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_o_revision
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_treasury_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_treasury_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_treasury_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_treasury_status
                    TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_o_owner
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                    TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
                    TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_o_case_serial
                    TICKET_STATE = 4
                }
            }
                if = {
                    limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                    zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_o_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_o_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_o_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_o_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_o_active
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_o_revision
                AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_gold_available
                RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_gold_reserved
                RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_gold_amount
                RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_gold_status
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_gold_owner
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_gold_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_gold_case
                TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_o_owner
                TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
                TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_o_case_serial
                TICKET_STATE = 4
                AMOUNT = 5
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_o_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_o_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_o_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_o_state
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_o_active
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_o_revision
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_gold_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_gold_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_gold_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m112_gold_status
                    TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_o_owner
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                    TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
                    TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_o_case_serial
                    TICKET_STATE = 4
                }
            }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1
                        var:zg361_ch_m112_treasury_status = 2
                        var:zg361_ch_m112_gold_status = 2
                    }
                    var:zg361_case_o_owner = {
                        remove_treasury = 5
                        add_gold = { value = 0 subtract = 5 }
                    }
                    add_treasury = 5
                    add_gold = 5
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m112_dual_payment_settled value = 1 }
                }
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m112_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m112_route value = scope:zg361_ch_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m112_value value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m112_value value = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m112_value value = -1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m112_deferred value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m112_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_o_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m112_consume_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m112_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_o_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_o_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_o_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_o_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_o_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_o_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_o_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_o_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m112_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m112_consumed = 0
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m112_value
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m112_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_completed add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m112_value > 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_favorable add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_used add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m112_value < 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_extractive add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m112_route = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_stay_promise_state value = var:zg361_ch_m112_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_stay_promise_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_o_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
        }


        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_o_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_o_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_o_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_o_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_o_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_o_try_advance_04_effect = yes
    }
}

    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {

            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = root

                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_o_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_o_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_o_cycle_serial

                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_o_state

# Open domain P on one assessed direct vassal.
zg361_career_hc_open_p_case_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            root = {
                zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
                has_variable = zg361_review_serial
            }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = root
        }
        zg361_case_p_open_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_authorized value = 7 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_available value = 7 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_used value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_debt value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_completed value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_favorable value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_extractive value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_outcome value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_conserved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_application_identity_visible value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_release_extension_used value = 0 }

        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_s2_x_deadline_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_s2_x_deadline_expired value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_s3_a_deadline_pending value = 0 }
