        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_s4_x_deadline_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_s4_x_deadline_expired value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_s5_x_deadline_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_s5_x_deadline_expired value = 0 }

            var:zg361_case_p_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_ch_p_event_owner }
            save_scope_as = zg361_ch_p_event_subject
            save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_p_event_cycle value = var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial }
            save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_p_event_case value = var:zg361_case_p_case_serial }
            zg361_career_hc_schedule_p_stage_01_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
                zg361_career_hc_p_run_authorized_ai_effect = yes
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { root = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
                root = { trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.114 days = 1 } }
            }
            debug_log = "ZG361CH: opened P career/HC case"
        }
    }
}

# Authorized second-AI-exception path: consume the same numbered
# receipts and consumers without opening any player business event.
zg361_career_hc_p_run_authorized_ai_effect = {
    if = {
            limit = {
                government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                root = {
                    government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                    treasury >= 5
                    gold >= 5
                }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m114_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            zg361_career_hc_m114_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 3 }
        }
    zg361_career_hc_m115_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    zg361_career_hc_m116_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    zg361_career_hc_m117_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    zg361_career_hc_m118_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    if = {
            limit = {
                government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                root = {
                    government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                    treasury >= 5
                    gold >= 5
                }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m119_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            zg361_career_hc_m119_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 3 }
        }
    zg361_career_hc_m120_manager_apply_effect = { ROUTE = 1 }
    if = {
            limit = { has_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied var:zg361_ch_runtime_applied = 1 }
            root = { trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.955 days = 1 } }
        }
}

zg361_career_hc_resolve_p_outcome_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:zg361_ch_p_completed = var:zg361_ch_p_authorized
            var:zg361_ch_p_conserved = 1
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_p_favorable > var:zg361_ch_p_extractive }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_outcome value = 1 }
            add_prestige = 50
            var:zg361_case_p_owner = { add_prestige = 25 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_p_extractive > var:zg361_ch_p_favorable }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_outcome value = -1 }
            add_stress = minor_stress_gain
            var:zg361_case_p_owner = { add_prestige = { value = 0 subtract = 25 } }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_outcome value = 0 }
            add_prestige = 10
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_visible_receipt_revision value = var:zg361_case_p_revision }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_p_owner = { is_ai = no } }
            var:zg361_case_p_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.905 days = 1 } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { is_ai = no }
            trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.905 days = 1 }
        }
        debug_log = "ZG361CH: completed P career/HC case"
    }
}

# Assessed-official self response; grants no manager/HC/panel authority.

        limit = {
            is_ai = no
            zg361_case_kernel_subject_self_guard_trigger = {
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_p_subject
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_p_active
            }
            has_variable = zg361_case_p_state
            var:zg361_case_p_state = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m114_subject_ack = 0
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 3
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m114_subject_ack value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m114_subject_route value = scope:zg361_ch_subject_route }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_case_p_feedback_revision add = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CH: subject response 114 recorded"
    }
}

# 114 经理“人才输出”积分
zg361_career_hc_m114_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_p_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_p_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_p_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_p_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_p_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_p_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_p_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m114_receipt_active
            var:zg361_ch_m114_receipt_active = 0
            trigger_if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                    }
                }
                government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                var:zg361_case_p_owner = {
                    government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                    treasury >= 5
                    gold >= 5
                }
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes }
        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_p_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_p_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_p_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_p_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_p_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_p_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_p_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_p_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_p_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_p_last_choice
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_p_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_p_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 1
            CHOICE = $ROUTE$
            OPERATION_ID = 114
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_p_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_p_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_p_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_p_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_p_active
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_p_revision
                AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_treasury_available
                RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_treasury_reserved
                RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_treasury_amount
                RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_treasury_status
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_treasury_owner
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_treasury_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_treasury_case
                TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_p_owner
                TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_p_case_serial
                TICKET_STATE = 1
                AMOUNT = 5
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_p_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_p_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_p_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_p_state
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_p_active
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_p_revision
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_treasury_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_treasury_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_treasury_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_treasury_status
                    TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_p_owner
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                    TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                    TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_p_case_serial
                    TICKET_STATE = 1
                }
            }
                if = {
                    limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                    zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_p_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_p_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_p_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_p_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_p_active
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_p_revision
                AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_gold_available
                RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_gold_reserved
                RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_gold_amount
                RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_gold_status
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_gold_owner
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_gold_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_gold_case
                TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_p_owner
                TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_p_case_serial
                TICKET_STATE = 1
                AMOUNT = 5
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_p_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_p_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_p_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_p_state
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_p_active
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_p_revision
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_gold_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_gold_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_gold_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m114_gold_status
                    TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_p_owner
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                    TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                    TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_p_case_serial
                    TICKET_STATE = 1
                }
            }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1
                        var:zg361_ch_m114_treasury_status = 2
                        var:zg361_ch_m114_gold_status = 2
                    }
                    var:zg361_case_p_owner = {
                        remove_treasury = 5
                        add_gold = { value = 0 subtract = 5 }
                    }
                    add_treasury = 5
                    add_gold = 5
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m114_dual_payment_settled value = 1 }
                }
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m114_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m114_route value = scope:zg361_ch_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m114_value value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m114_value value = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m114_value value = -1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m114_deferred value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m114_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m114_consume_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m114_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_p_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_p_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_p_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_p_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_p_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_p_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_p_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m114_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m114_consumed = 0
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m114_value
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m114_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_completed add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m114_value > 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_favorable add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_used add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m114_value < 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_extractive add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m114_route = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_talent_export_credit value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_backfill_settled value = 1 }
        }


        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_p_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_p_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_p_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_p_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_p_try_advance_01_effect = yes
    }
}

# Assessed-official self response; grants no manager/HC/panel authority.
zg361_career_hc_m116_subject_response_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_subject_route value = $ROUTE$ }

        limit = {
            is_ai = no

                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_p_subject
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_p_active
            }
            has_variable = zg361_case_p_state
            var:zg361_case_p_state = 2
            var:zg361_ch_m116_subject_ack = 0
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 3
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m116_subject_ack value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m116_subject_route value = scope:zg361_ch_subject_route }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_case_p_feedback_revision add = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CH: subject response 116 recorded"
    }
}

# 116 放人时限与一次交接延期
zg361_career_hc_m116_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_p_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_p_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_p_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_p_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_p_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_p_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_p_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 2
            }
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m116_receipt_active
            var:zg361_ch_m116_receipt_active = 0

        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_p_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_p_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_p_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_p_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_p_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_p_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_p_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_p_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_p_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_p_last_choice
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m116_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ch_m116_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m116_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m116_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ch_m116_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ch_m116_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_p_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_p_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 2
            CHOICE = $ROUTE$
            OPERATION_ID = 116
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m116_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m116_route value = scope:zg361_ch_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m116_value value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m116_value value = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m116_value value = -1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m116_deferred value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m116_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m116_consume_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m116_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_p_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_p_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_p_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_p_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_p_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_p_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_p_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 2
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m116_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m116_consumed = 0
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m116_value
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m116_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_completed add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m116_value > 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_favorable add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_used add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m116_value < 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_extractive add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m116_route = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_release_days value = 90 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_release_extension_used value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_ch_m116_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_release_days value = 150 } set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_release_extension_used value = 1 } }
        }
        else = {
            # A timed defer still needs a bounded release clock; it does not
            # consume the single evidence-backed sixty-day extension.
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_release_days value = 90 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_release_extension_used value = 0 }
        }


        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_p_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_p_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_p_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_p_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_p_try_advance_02_effect = yes
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m117_manager_apply_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            root = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = root
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_p_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_p_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_p_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_p_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_p_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = root
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_p_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 3
            }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_m117_core_effect = { ROUTE = $ROUTE$ }
    }
}

                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_p_active
            }
            has_variable = zg361_case_p_state

            var:zg361_ch_m117_subject_ack = 0

                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 3

        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m117_subject_route value = scope:zg361_ch_subject_route }

    }
}

            has_variable = zg361_case_p_state
            var:zg361_case_p_state = 4
            var:zg361_ch_m119_subject_ack = 0
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 3
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m119_subject_ack value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m119_subject_route value = scope:zg361_ch_subject_route }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_case_p_feedback_revision add = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CH: subject response 119 recorded"
    }
}

# 119 招聘质量回写
zg361_career_hc_m119_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_p_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_p_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_p_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_p_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_p_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_p_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_p_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m119_receipt_active
            var:zg361_ch_m119_receipt_active = 0
            trigger_if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                    }
                }
                government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                var:zg361_case_p_owner = {
                    government_has_flag = government_has_treasury
                    treasury >= 5
                    gold >= 5
                }
            }
            trigger_else = { always = yes }
        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_p_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_p_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_p_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_p_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_p_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_p_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_p_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_p_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_p_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_p_last_choice
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_p_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_p_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 4
            CHOICE = $ROUTE$
            OPERATION_ID = 119
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                        scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                    }
                }
                zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_p_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_p_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_p_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_p_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_p_active
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_p_revision
                AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_treasury_available
                RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_treasury_reserved
                RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_treasury_amount
                RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_treasury_status
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_treasury_owner
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_treasury_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_treasury_case
                TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_p_owner
                TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_p_case_serial
                TICKET_STATE = 4
                AMOUNT = 5
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_p_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_p_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_p_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_p_state
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_p_active
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_p_revision
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_treasury_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_treasury_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_treasury_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_treasury_status
                    TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_p_owner
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                    TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                    TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_p_case_serial
                    TICKET_STATE = 4
                }
            }
                if = {
                    limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                    zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_p_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_p_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_p_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_p_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_p_active
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_p_revision
                AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_gold_available
                RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_gold_reserved
                RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_gold_amount
                RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_gold_status
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_gold_owner
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_gold_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_gold_case
                TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_p_owner
                TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_p_case_serial
                TICKET_STATE = 4
                AMOUNT = 5
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
                    OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_p_owner
                    SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_p_subject
                    CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                    CASE_VAR = zg361_case_p_case_serial
                    STATE_VAR = zg361_case_p_state
                    ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_p_active
                    REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_p_revision
                    RESERVED_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_gold_reserved
                    SETTLED_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_gold_settled
                    RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_gold_amount
                    RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_ch_m119_gold_status
                    TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_p_owner
                    TICKET_SUBJECT = this
                    TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                    TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_p_case_serial
                    TICKET_STATE = 4
                }
            }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1
                        var:zg361_ch_m119_treasury_status = 2
                        var:zg361_ch_m119_gold_status = 2
                    }
                    var:zg361_case_p_owner = {
                        remove_treasury = 5
                        add_gold = { value = 0 subtract = 5 }
                    }
                    add_treasury = 5
                    add_gold = 5
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m119_dual_payment_settled value = 1 }
                }
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m119_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m119_route value = scope:zg361_ch_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m119_value value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m119_value value = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m119_value value = -1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m119_deferred value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m119_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m119_consume_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m119_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_p_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_p_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_p_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_p_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_p_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_p_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_p_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m119_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m119_consumed = 0
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m119_value
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m119_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_completed add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m119_value > 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_favorable add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_used add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m119_value < 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_extractive add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m119_route = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hiring_quality_outcome value = var:zg361_ch_m119_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_hiring_quality_receivers value = 3 }
        }


        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_p_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_p_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_p_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_p_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_p_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_p_try_advance_04_effect = yes
    }
}

            liege = root
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_p_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_p_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_p_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_p_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_p_active

                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_p_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 5
            }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_m120_core_effect = { ROUTE = $ROUTE$ }
    }
}

            is_ai = no
            zg361_case_kernel_subject_self_guard_trigger = {
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_p_subject
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_p_active
            }
            has_variable = zg361_case_p_state
            var:zg361_case_p_state = 5
            var:zg361_ch_m120_subject_ack = 0
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_subject_route = 3
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m120_subject_ack value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m120_subject_route value = scope:zg361_ch_subject_route }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_case_p_feedback_revision add = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CH: subject response 120 recorded"
    }
}

            }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:zg361_ch_q_named_successor_candidate_scope }

                    name = zg361_ch_q_named_successor_candidate

                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = zg361_ch_q_named_survey_respondent
                    value = scope:zg361_ch_q_named_successor_candidate_scope
                }
            }
            var:zg361_case_q_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_ch_q_event_owner }
            save_scope_as = zg361_ch_q_event_subject
            save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_q_event_cycle value = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial }
            save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_q_event_case value = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial }
            zg361_career_hc_schedule_q_stage_01_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
                zg361_career_hc_q_run_authorized_ai_effect = yes
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { root = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
                root = { trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.121 days = 1 } }
            }
            debug_log = "ZG361CH: opened Q career/HC case"
        }
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_resolve_q_outcome_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:zg361_ch_q_completed = var:zg361_ch_q_authorized
            var:zg361_ch_q_conserved = 1
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_q_favorable > var:zg361_ch_q_extractive }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_outcome value = 1 }
            add_prestige = 50
            var:zg361_case_q_owner = { add_prestige = 25 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_q_extractive > var:zg361_ch_q_favorable }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_outcome value = -1 }
            add_stress = minor_stress_gain
            var:zg361_case_q_owner = { add_prestige = { value = 0 subtract = 25 } }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_outcome value = 0 }
            add_prestige = 10
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_visible_receipt_revision value = var:zg361_case_q_revision }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_q_owner = { is_ai = no } }
            var:zg361_case_q_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.906 days = 1 } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { is_ai = no }
            trigger_event = { id = zg361ch.906 days = 1 }
        }
        debug_log = "ZG361CH: completed Q career/HC case"
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m121_manager_apply_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            root = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = root
            zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_q_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_q_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_q_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_q_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_q_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = root
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_m121_core_effect = { ROUTE = $ROUTE$ }
    }
}

# 121 首次任经理试运行
zg361_career_hc_m121_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_q_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_q_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_q_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_q_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_q_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_q_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m121_receipt_active
            var:zg361_ch_m121_receipt_active = 0

        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_q_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_q_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_q_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_q_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_q_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_q_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_q_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_q_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_q_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_q_last_choice
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m121_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ch_m121_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m121_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m121_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ch_m121_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ch_m121_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_q_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 1
            CHOICE = $ROUTE$
            OPERATION_ID = 121
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m121_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m121_route value = scope:zg361_ch_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m121_value value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m121_value value = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m121_value value = -1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m121_deferred value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m121_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m121_consume_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m121_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_q_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_q_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_q_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_q_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_q_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_q_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m121_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m121_consumed = 0
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m121_value
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m121_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_completed add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m121_value > 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_favorable add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_used add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m121_value < 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_extractive add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m121_route = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_manager_trial_team_size value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_manager_trial_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
        }

        zg361_career_hc_m121_business_consumer_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_q_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_q_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_q_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_q_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_q_try_advance_01_effect = yes
    }
}

                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial

        zg361_career_hc_m122_core_effect = { ROUTE = $ROUTE$ }
    }
}

# 122 管理者 4-3-3 记分卡
zg361_career_hc_m122_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_q_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_q_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_q_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_q_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_q_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_q_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m122_receipt_active
            var:zg361_ch_m122_receipt_active = 0

        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_q_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_q_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_q_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_q_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_q_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_q_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_q_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_q_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_q_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_q_last_choice
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m122_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ch_m122_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m122_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m122_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ch_m122_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ch_m122_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_q_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 1
            CHOICE = $ROUTE$
            OPERATION_ID = 122
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m122_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m122_route value = scope:zg361_ch_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m122_value value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m122_value value = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m122_value value = -1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m122_deferred value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m122_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            }

        limit = {

                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_q_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_q_case_serial

                EXPECTED_STATE = 1
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m122_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m122_consumed = 0
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m122_value
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m122_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_completed add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m122_value > 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_favorable add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_used add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m122_value < 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_extractive add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m122_route = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_manager_weight_hard value = 40 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_manager_weight_people value = 30 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_manager_weight_values value = 30 }
        }

        zg361_career_hc_m122_business_consumer_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_q_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_q_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_q_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_q_authorized }

# 123 下属评经理专表
zg361_career_hc_m123_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_q_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_q_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_q_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_q_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_q_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_q_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 2
            }
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m123_receipt_active
            var:zg361_ch_m123_receipt_active = 0

        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_q_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_q_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_q_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_q_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_q_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_q_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_q_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_q_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_q_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_q_last_choice
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m123_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ch_m123_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m123_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m123_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ch_m123_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ch_m123_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_q_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 2
            CHOICE = $ROUTE$
            OPERATION_ID = 123
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m123_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m123_route value = scope:zg361_ch_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m123_value value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m123_value value = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m123_value value = -1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m123_deferred value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m123_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m123_consume_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m124_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_q_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_q_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_q_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_q_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_q_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_q_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 2
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m124_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m124_consumed = 0
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m124_value
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m124_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_completed add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m124_value > 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_favorable add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_used add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m124_value < 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_extractive add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m124_route = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_successor_accepted value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_manager_promotion_released value = 1 }
        }

        zg361_career_hc_m124_business_consumer_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_q_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_q_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_q_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_q_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_q_try_advance_02_effect = yes
    }
}

    if = {
        limit = {

                scope:zg361_ch_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {

                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 3
            }
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m125_receipt_active
            var:zg361_ch_m125_receipt_active = 0

        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_q_owner

            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_q_cycle_serial

zg361_career_hc_m125_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_q_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_q_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_q_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_q_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_q_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_q_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 3
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m125_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m125_consumed = 0
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m125_value
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m125_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_completed add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m125_value > 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_favorable add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_used add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m125_value < 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_extractive add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m125_route = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_crisis_hours_budget value = 100 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_crisis_hours_used value = 100 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_successor_evidence value = 1 }
        }

        zg361_career_hc_m125_business_consumer_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_q_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_q_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_q_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_q_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_q_try_advance_03_effect = yes
    }
}

            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m125_business_object_count add = 1 }
            set_variable = {
                name = zg361_ch_m125_succession_object_id
                value = {

                    multiply = 1000
                    add = 1252
                }
            }

            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m125_succession_object_candidate value = var:zg361_ch_q_named_successor_candidate }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m125_business_object_count add = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_ch_q_crisis_hours_available >= 100 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_crisis_hours_available add = -100 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_crisis_hours_manager add = 100 }
                change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_crisis_hours_delegated add = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m125_business_capacity_applied value = 1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m125_business_capacity_applied value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m125_business_debt value = 1 }
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_crisis_hours_budget value = 100 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_crisis_manager_hours value = 100 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_crisis_delegated_hours value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_successor_evidence value = 0 }

            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_crisis_hours_partition add = var:zg361_ch_q_crisis_hours_manager }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_crisis_hours_conserved value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_ch_q_crisis_hours_partition = var:zg361_ch_q_crisis_hours_authorized }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_crisis_hours_conserved value = 1 }
            }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m125_business_capacity_applied value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m125_business_debt value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m125_business_object_count value = 0 }

            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_crisis_hours_partition add = var:zg361_ch_q_crisis_hours_manager }

            }
            }

        }
        else = {

# 126 绩效 × 价值观处置矩阵
zg361_career_hc_m126_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_q_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_q_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_q_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_q_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_q_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_q_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 3
            }
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m126_receipt_active
            var:zg361_ch_m126_receipt_active = 0

        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_q_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_q_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_q_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_q_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_q_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_q_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_q_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_q_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_q_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_q_last_choice
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m126_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ch_m126_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m126_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m126_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ch_m126_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ch_m126_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_q_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 3
            CHOICE = $ROUTE$
            OPERATION_ID = 126
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m126_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m126_route value = scope:zg361_ch_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m126_value value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m126_value value = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m126_value value = -1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m126_deferred value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m126_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m126_consume_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m126_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_q_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_q_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_q_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_q_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_q_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_q_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 3
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m126_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m126_consumed = 0
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m126_value
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m126_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_completed add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m126_value > 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_favorable add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_used add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m126_value < 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_extractive add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m126_route = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_values_quadrant value = var:zg361_ch_m126_route }
        }

        zg361_career_hc_m126_business_consumer_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_q_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_q_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_q_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_q_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_q_try_advance_03_effect = yes
    }
}

            OPERATION_ID = 127
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m127_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m127_route value = scope:zg361_ch_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m127_value value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m127_value value = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m127_value value = -1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m127_deferred value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m127_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m127_consume_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m127_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_q_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_q_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_q_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_q_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_q_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_q_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m127_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m127_consumed = 0
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m127_value
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m127_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_completed add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m127_value > 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_favorable add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_used add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m127_value < 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_extractive add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m127_route = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_span_frozen value = 8 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_span_excess value = 3 }
        }

        zg361_career_hc_m127_business_consumer_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_q_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_q_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_q_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_q_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_q_try_advance_04_effect = yes
    }
}

    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
