            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            liege = root
            zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_q_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_q_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_q_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_q_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_q_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = root
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_m128_core_effect = { ROUTE = $ROUTE$ }
    }
}

# 128 强制分布气候指标
zg361_career_hc_m128_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_ch_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_runtime_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 1
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 2
                scope:zg361_ch_route = 3
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_q_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_q_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_q_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_q_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_q_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_q_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m128_receipt_active
            var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_active = 0

        }
        zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
            OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_q_owner
            SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_q_subject
            CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
            CASE_VAR = zg361_case_q_case_serial
            STATE_VAR = zg361_case_q_state
            ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_q_active
            REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_q_revision
            TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_q_timeline_serial
            FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_q_feedback_revision
            LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_q_last_operation
            LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_q_last_choice
            RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ch_m128_receipt_owner
            RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ch_m128_receipt_subject
            RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ch_m128_receipt_cycle
            RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ch_m128_receipt_case
            RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ch_m128_receipt_state
            RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ch_m128_receipt_route
            TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_q_owner
            TICKET_SUBJECT = this
            TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
            TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial
            TICKET_STATE = 4
            CHOICE = $ROUTE$
            OPERATION_ID = 128
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_receipt_active value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_route value = scope:zg361_ch_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_value value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_value value = 1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { scope:zg361_ch_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_value value = -1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_deferred value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            }
            zg361_career_hc_m128_consume_effect = yes
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_runtime_applied value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

zg361_career_hc_m128_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_q_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_q_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_q_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_q_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_q_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_q_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m128_consumed = 0
            has_variable = zg361_ch_m128_value
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_consumed value = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_completed add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m128_value > 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_favorable add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_used add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m128_value < 0 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_extractive add = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_available add = -1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_used add = 1 }
        }
        else = { change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_debt add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_ch_m128_route = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_climate_snapshot_cycle value = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_next_cycle_quota_policy value = var:zg361_ch_m128_route }
        }

        zg361_career_hc_m128_business_consumer_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_capacity_partition value = var:zg361_ch_q_available }
        change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_capacity_partition add = var:zg361_ch_q_used }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_conserved value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_q_capacity_partition = var:zg361_ch_q_authorized }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_conserved value = 1 }
        }
        zg361_career_hc_q_try_advance_04_effect = yes
    }
}

# Q128 authoritative typed-object consumer; manager-governance is adapter-only.
zg361_career_hc_m128_business_consumer_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_ch_q_business_applied
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_q_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_q_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_q_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_q_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_q_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_q_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
            var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m128_consumed = 1
            var:zg361_ch_m128_business_consumed = 0
            var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_q_owner
            var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_subject = this
            var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial
            var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial
            var:zg361_ch_m128_receipt_state = 4
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_business_consumed value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_business_owner value = var:zg361_case_q_owner }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_business_subject value = this }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_business_cycle value = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_business_case value = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_business_state value = 4 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_business_revision value = var:zg361_case_q_revision }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m128_route = 1 }
            set_variable = {
                name = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_id
                value = {
                    value = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial
                    multiply = 1000
                    add = 1281
                }
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_q_owner }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_subject value = this }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_case value = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_state value = 4 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_revision value = var:zg361_case_q_revision }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_route value = var:zg361_ch_m128_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_active value = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_business_object_count add = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_climate_pressure value = 70 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_climate_collaboration value = 55 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_climate_risk_reporting value = 45 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_climate_peer_credibility value = 60 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_climate_regrettable_attrition value = 20 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_next_cycle_quota_policy value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_next_cycle_quota_policy_effective_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_current_cycle_quota_policy_unchanged value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_ch_m128_route = 2 }
            set_variable = {
                name = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_id
                value = {
                    value = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial
                    multiply = 1000
                    add = 1281
                }
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_q_owner }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_subject value = this }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_case value = var:zg361_case_q_case_serial }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_state value = 4 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_revision value = var:zg361_case_q_revision }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_route value = var:zg361_ch_m128_route }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_manager_object_active value = 1 }
            change_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_business_object_count add = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_climate_pressure value = 70 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_climate_collaboration value = 55 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_climate_risk_reporting value = 45 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_climate_peer_credibility value = 60 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_climate_regrettable_attrition value = 20 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_next_cycle_quota_policy value = 2 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_next_cycle_quota_policy_effective_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_q_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_current_cycle_quota_policy_unchanged value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_business_debt value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_business_deferred value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_business_debt value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_m128_business_object_count value = 0 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_q_business_applied value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CH: authoritative Q business consumer 128 committed"
    }
}

# Close the manager portfolio only against the last domain's frozen identity.
zg361_career_hc_finalize_p_portfolio_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:zg361_ch_p_event_owner
            exists = scope:zg361_ch_p_event_subject
            exists = scope:zg361_ch_p_event_cycle
            exists = scope:zg361_ch_p_event_case
            var:zg361_case_p_owner = scope:zg361_ch_p_event_owner
            var:zg361_case_p_subject = scope:zg361_ch_p_event_subject
            var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial = scope:zg361_ch_p_event_cycle
            var:zg361_case_p_case_serial = scope:zg361_ch_p_event_case
            var:zg361_case_p_state = 6
            var:zg361_case_p_active = 0
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_portfolio_closed value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_portfolio_final_owner value = var:zg361_case_p_owner }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_portfolio_final_subject value = var:zg361_case_p_subject }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_portfolio_final_cycle value = var:zg361_case_p_cycle_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_portfolio_final_case value = var:zg361_case_p_case_serial }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_portfolio_final_state value = var:zg361_case_p_state }
        var:zg361_case_p_owner = {
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_manager_portfolio_active value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_ch_manager_portfolio_completed_cycle value = var:zg361_review_serial }
        }
        debug_log = "ZG361CH: manager career/HC portfolio closed after P"
    }
}
